name: MORSE-500
intro: MORSE-500是一个可程序控制的视频多模态推理压力测试，含500个内嵌问题的视频实例，覆盖抽象、数学、物理、规划、空间和时间六类推理。所有视频均通过确定性Python脚本生成，脚本可按实体数量、推理深度、干扰密度、时间动态和视觉复杂度扩展难度，并可在物理任务中纳入真实场景或视频生成模型素材；自动技术验证与作者人类评审共同保证可复现质量。
org: University of Maryland, College Park, Capital One
build_method: 程序化生成, 自动与人类质检
eval_feature: 六类推理, 可扩展难度, 内嵌问题
build_method_en: Programmatic Generation, Automated and Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Six reasoning categories, scalable difficulty, embedded questions
intro_en: MORSE-500 is a programmatically controllable video reasoning stress test with 500 question-embedded instances spanning abstract, mathematical, physical, planning, spatial, and temporal reasoning. Every video is generated through deterministic Python scripts that scale entity count, reasoning depth, distractor density, temporal dynamics, and visual complexity while incorporating real-world scenarios or video-generation material for suitable physics tasks; automated technical checks and author review enforce reproducible quality.

drawio_review_note: Source audit locked to arXiv:2506.05523v1 (the only paper version available on 2026-07-21), official GitHub commit 07743de968fe3e64f9797eb327f2811aac4adafb, and Hugging Face dataset revision 2f441908e0f524c49ded73dee00a3ee5527cfa35. The diagram preserves the six-category taxonomy; task adaptation; expert prototype, deterministic script, parameterization, and embedded-question stages; exact automated and author-review criteria with two-to-three-iteration feedback; 500-video/3.1-hour/category totals; 512-pixel and native-video-versus-2-FPS/32-frame evaluation routes; fixed prompt; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ extraction; extraction-exception retention; exact string matching; and the remaining-row accuracy denominator. The released scorer converts gold values with astype(str) and strip, excludes only stripped-empty values or the literal non, and therefore retains parser-produced missing values as the literal nan. Public access is verified; the dataset card declares CC BY 4.0, while the code repository LICENSE is CC BY-SA 4.0. The paper does not report inter-rater agreement or a complete per-item human-review coverage rate, so neither is asserted. Formal publication evidence [site-a11p-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1605×905 (English) and 1605×905 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1603×903 and 1603×903. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
